sentences.quote: Master Development Program 2026-2030 commits Ps. 17,420 million in investments, focusing on capacity, quality, and environmental projects.
sentences.text: Grupo Aeroportuario del Centro Norte, known as OMA, operates under long-term concessions for 13 Mexican airports, with regulators approving its 2026-2030 Master Development Program committing Ps.16,005 million and setting maximum tariffs per workload unit for each airport.
Monterrey anchors the portfolio at 51% of group passengers, and OMA is investing MX$8 billion there between 2026 and 2030 to position it as Mexico's primary aviation hub.

sentences.quote: Passenger traffic rose 0.4% to 7.2 million, adjusted EBITDA increased 6.2% to MXN 2.7 billion, and net income grew 10.2% to MXN 1.5 billion. Revenue growth and disciplined cost control lifted the adjusted EBITDA margin to 75.2%.
sentences.text: Margins are high and improving: second-quarter 2026 adjusted EBITDA rose 6.2% to MXN 2.7 billion and net income 10.2% to MXN 1.5 billion, lifting the adjusted EBITDA margin to 75.2%.

sentences.quote: Non-aeronautical revenues increased 9.8%, with commercial up 6.7% and diversification up 17.4%.
sentences.text: Non-aeronautical revenues grew 9.8%, with commercial up 6.7% and diversification up 17.4%, broadening income beyond passenger charges.

sentences.quote: Net debt/adjusted EBITDA at 1.03x; cash position at quarter-end was Ps.2,577 million.
sentences.text: Leverage remains low at 1.03x net debt to adjusted EBITDA, supporting capital returns such as the MXN 4.9 billion cash dividend approved.

thesis_pillars.text: Margins are high and improving: second-quarter 2026 adjusted EBITDA rose 6.2% to MXN 2.7 billion and net income 10.2% to MXN 1.5 billion, lifting the adjusted EBITDA margin to 75.2%. Non-aeronautical revenues grew 9.8%, with commercial up 6.7% and diversification up 17.4%, broadening income beyond passenger charges. Leverage remains low at 1.03x net debt to adjusted EBITDA, supporting capital returns such as the MXN 4.9 billion cash dividend approved.
